text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having taken on a request,
Hiyori finds herself out of town on her own.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この日、ヒヨリは仕事の依頼を受けて、
街の外に一人で出てきていた。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Take this!
text_block_list.orig_text: とりゃーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Rrrrghhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
That's one down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はぁーっ……
まずは一匹っと！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Weird, though. Monsters shouldn't be appearing in a busy area like this...
Either way, I gotta wipe them out before someone gets hurt!
text_block_list.orig_text:
人通りのある場所なのに、
魔物が出るようになるなんて……
誰かが襲われる前に、
パパッと退治しなきゃ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Another one?!
I'm pretty sure it came from over there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっそくもう一匹！？
あっちから聞こえたけど……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Oh, shoot! It's attacking someone! I gotta act quick!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って誰か襲われてる！！　
助けに行かなきゃっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay?!
Don't worry, I'll—
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫ですか！？
助けに来ました──

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Mr. Knight?! Heyo!
Didn't think I'd bump into you here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？　
騎士くん！？　
やっほー！
こんなところで会えるなんて嬉しいよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Mind if I ask what—
text_block_list.orig_text: 騎士くんは何して──

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Whoops! Ehehe, guess now isn't the time for chat.
Lemme take care of this thing first!
Punchy punchy punch!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっとっと！　
えへへっ、
話してる場合じゃなかったね！
まずは魔物を倒しちゃうよ！
うりゃりゃりゃーっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Rrrrghhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Phew... At least it was pretty weak.
Now we've got plenty of time to catch up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ……
あんまり強くなくてよかった。
これでゆっくりお話できるね！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't worry. No need to thank me.
I'm out on a monster-hunting request today,
so I was just doing my job.
text_block_list.orig_text:
助けたお礼なんて、
いいよ。
今日は魔物退治の依頼を受けてるんだ。
いまのはお仕事の一環だから気にしないで！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: So anyway, what're you doing here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ところで、
騎士くんはなにしてるの？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're out on a delivery? And it's just past here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
配達のお仕事……？　
森を抜けた先のとこに？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Well that makes sense, but this place is full of monsters right now.
It's way too dangerous on your own.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもこの辺りは今、
魔物がたくさんいるし……
騎士くんだけで行くのは危ないよ？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well this is tricky.
You can't just ditch your work, either.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん……
やっぱりお仕事は
途中でやめられないよね……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how about this?
If you're in a pickle, then I can just help you out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだっ！
騎士くんが困ってるなら、
私が助ければいいんだっ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Or... maybe not, actually.
I'm in the middle of work myself.
These monsters won't wipe themselves out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……って言いたいんだけどなぁ……
実はあたしも魔物退治のお仕事で、
手が離せなくて。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
These woods normally aren't that bad, but today's a special case.
Honestly, there's enough that I might not even be able to handle them all myself!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この森の中にはね、
魔物がたっくさんいるんだって。
それも、
あたし一人で全部退治しきれるか分かんないくらい！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
So yeah. Much as I want to help you out, I dunno if I can.
Wouldn't mind some help myself, if I'm being honest!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう聞いてたからむしろ助っ人が欲しいくらいで、
今のあたしに騎士くんをお手伝いできるかな……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I'm seriously stumped here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん……
どうしたら？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Wait, no I'm not! My brain juices just got flowing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あーっ！　
いいこと思いついちゃった！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: I wanna help you out. That's just a fact.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしやっぱり、
騎士くんのお手伝いするよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
So... How about you help me out too, in exchange?
You're the perfect pair of hands I need for these monsters!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その代わりに……
騎士くんもあたしのこと、
手伝ってくれない？
魔物退治に協力してほしいんだ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
With the two of us together, we'll clean them out in no time!
Once that's done, 
I'll help you out with your delivery.
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人なら、
きっとすぐに終わっちゃうよ！
それに魔物を退治しちゃえば、
騎士くんもお仕事がやりやすいよね？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
A perfect plan, if you ask me! And with that settled, 
let's get to it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんうん！　
カンッペキだね！
というわけで、
一緒に助け合おーっ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Huh? C-come on, no need to thank me.
We're both helping each other out here!
I scratch your back, you scratch mine!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
お、
お礼なんていいよ。
あたしも手伝ってもらうんだから！
困ったときはお互いさまさま！　
だよっ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: And with that said, let's get to hunting!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあさっそく、
魔物退治にしゅっぱ～つ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Rrrrghhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Down it goes! Nice and easy, too.
Fighting along with you really makes things go smoother!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったぁ！　
順調順調！
騎士くんが一緒に戦ってくれるおかげだねっ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Man though, the leader of the pack sure isn't showing up.
If we took that down, then all the others would probably scatter.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
群れのボスがなかなか見つからないや……
ボスが倒せたら、
他の魔物は逃げてくと思うんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
According to the info I got,
it's the sort of monster that goes into hiding at night.
So we gotta find it fast, or else!
text_block_list.orig_text:
依頼を受けた時に聞いたのは、
ボスは日が暮れたら、
どこかに隠れちゃうんだって。
だから、
なるべく早めに見つけないと……！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GROOOAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Th-that sure was a roar...!
Chances are the leader's near by, so let's go check!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わわっ！　
す、
すごい声……！？
もしかしたらボスが近くにいるのかも！　
行ってみよう！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Bingo!
That's it over there! We finally found it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……やっと見つけた！
騎士くん見て、
あれがボスだよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
No time to waste, though.
Let's take it down nice and quick! Hahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アイツはあたしがやっつけちゃうね！
先手必勝っ！！　
たあーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
For real?!
It just brushed me off like nothing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うそっ！？
受け止められちゃった！？

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Graaaaarghhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
And now we're surrounded!
Don't tell me... Did they actually lure me in?
text_block_list.orig_text:
後ろにも魔物が！！
もしかしてあたし、
誘い込まれちゃった……！？

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Graaaaarghhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Urgh! I-I think I'm done for!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁ！　
や、
やられる……！！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Mr. Knight?! Thanks, I appreciate it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士くん！！　
助けにきてくれたんだ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I let that happen... Thanks, though!
Do me a favor and keep them busy! I'll take the leader down quick!
Round two, here we go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
つい誘いに乗っちゃって……
ありがと！
少しだけ魔物を抑えてて！　
ボスはすぐに倒しちゃうから！
いくぞぉぉぉぉっ！　
とりゃーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Let's see...
According to the map, your delivery spot should be just up ahead.
text_block_list.orig_text:
地図によると……
荷物の届け先は、
もう少し行ったところにある街だね。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Think you can make it there on your own?
Cool, good to hear! I'll head back to town first, then.
text_block_list.orig_text:
案内はここまででいいの？
そっか！　
じゃあ、
あたしは先に街まで戻ってるね！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Also, while I'm here. Thanks again for the help earlier.
Things might've turned out real bad if it hadn't been for you.
And hey, we managed to take down the leader of the pack as well!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士くん！　
さっきは助けてくれてありがとう！
もうちょっとでやられるところだったけど……
騎士くんのおかげで、
無事にボスも倒せたし！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Thanks alone doesn't feel like enough, though.
Is there anything you'd like, by chance?
choice_data_list: No need to repay me. I just helped out on instinct.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お礼がしたいんだけど、
あたしにやって欲しいこと、
ないかな？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Let's have a think together, then.
Hmm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしも一緒に考えてみるね！
うーん……？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Oh, how about this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ、
そうだ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you're just like me then!
It just doesn't feel right to ignore people in need, does it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしとおんなじだ！
やっぱり困ってる人がいたら、
放っておけないよね！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
This can be a little deal between us.
If you're ever in a bind, then pay me a visit.
Who knows, I might just be able to help you out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士くん！
これからは困ったことがあったら、
いつでも相談して！
助けになれるかも知れないし！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Huh...? So basically, you wanna help me out as well?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……？　
あたしが困った時に、
騎士くんが……？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Okay, then. Guess I'll take you up on that!
I'm the one who went on about scratching each other's backs and all that,
so yeah. Makes sense. Thanks again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ……
その時は、
頼りにさせてもらっちゃおうかな！
困った時はお互いさまさまって言ったの、
あたしだもんね。
騎士くん、
ありがとう！！
